items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Your sister's name again was what? >> INTERVIEWEE: Katie Bryant.

ctx.x: Your sister's name again was what?

Katie. Yeah. Uh huh. And...oh, you talked about goin' out into the country to visit your kinfolk in the summertime when you were livin' in Kansas City, and you told me off the tape that that was about a hundred miles out in the country, right?
